name: How do appraisers determine the value of a tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do appraisers determine the value of a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appraisers determine the value of a tiny home by considering several factors, including its size, condition, construction quality, and unique features. They also look at its location and whether it's permanently affixed to land or mobile. The most common method involves comparing it to recently sold tiny homes or similar alternative dwellings in the local market. Adjustments are made for differences in amenities, age, and property characteristics to arrive at a fair market value. The legal classification of the tiny home (e.g., real property vs. chattel) significantly impacts the valuation approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Appraisers consider size, condition, features, location, and compare it to similar recent sales to determine a tiny home's value.
